message: The [SuspendInvariantsAttribute] aspect on method '{0}' is redundant because the type '{1}' does not contain any invariants.
title: The [SuspendInvariantsAttribute] aspect is redundant because the type does not contain any invariants.
rationale: The message lacks the word 'because' ('is redundant the type'). The title is an interpolated string containing '[${nameof(...)}]', so it renders as '[$SuspendInvariantsAttribute]' with a stray dollar sign.
codeChange: The definition in ContractDiagnostics.cs passes no category, unlike the other contract diagnostics; add "Metalama.Patterns.Contracts" as the category argument.
